jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
What we do. Electric Car Leasing 
 

 Why we do it. Greener. Fairer. Future. 
 

 

 
 
 We are looking for a super collaborative Product Manager to join our London team, to help grow one of Octopus Energy Group’s most exciting businesses and accelerate the driving public on their energy transition. 

 

 We are building a whole new way for drivers to join the electric revolution. 

 Not only can they learn about and shop for their EV online, but also experience a ‘lease for life’ through an industry-changing customer experience. 

 

 The Product team is crucial in defining and bringing to market this vision while working hand in hand with all teams across the company to deliver it in record time. 

 What you'll do... 
 

 
 Define and deliver a prioritised roadmap of measurable outcomes

 
 Run regular user research and interviews to understand jobs to be done

 
 Test hypotheses through analytics, frequent shippable increments and iterative experiments

 
 Use data to identify opportunities and track success

 
 Demonstrate progress and direction of travel through storytelling and inclusive communication at every level of our business

 
 Leverage modern tooling, including AI, to accelerate time to value

 
 Collaborate company wide with high level of autonomy

 What you'll need... 
 

 
 Strong experience as a Product Manager owning software products end-to-end 

 
 Track record of delivery in fast-paced and cross-functional environments

 
 Proficiency with shaping workflows and tooling for internal teams

 
 Strong storytelling and relationship-building skills 

 
 Fluency with SQL and product analytics

 
 Technical literacy and comfort collaborating with engineers

 
 Demonstrable ability to thrive in high freedom, high agency culture 

 
 Interest in sustainability, green energy and zero-emissions transport.

 Any of the following would be a bonus 

 
 Technical skills. We don't need you to be a Product Engineer, but any Python experience or experience working with technical teams would be an advantage

 
 Running AB Tests

 Why you'll love it here 

 Don't feel like you meet all of our hiring criteria? Thats OK, apply anyway! We'd love to hear from you and have a conversation.

 Octopus Electric Vehicles , part of the Octopus Energy Group, won the Sunday Times best company to work for in 2024. We were named 6th out of the top 100 start-ups to work for by Tempo in 2025 and on Glassdoor we were voted 50 best places to work in 2022 . Our Group CEO, Greg has recorded a podcast about our culture and how we empower our people 

 Wondering what the salary for this role is? Just ask us! On a call with one of our recruiters it's something we always cover as we genuinely want to match your experience with the correct salary. The reason why we don't advertise is because we honestly have a degree of flexibility and would never want salary to be a reason why someone doesn't apply to Octopus - what's more important to us is finding the right octofit!

 Octopus Energy Group is a unique culture . An organisation where people learn, decide, and build quicker. Where people work with autonomy, alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground. We want your hard work to be rewarded with perks you actually care about! Visit our perks hub - Octopus Employee Benefits 

 Things to Note... 
 

 🐶 just to let you know, we are dog friendly company so you may see our 4 legged friends in the offices - feel free to bring yours! Rest assured though, we've taken lots of precautions for those who have allergies 

 🤖 We use AI to help us assess applications fairly and objectively. We’re totally fine with you using AI as a tool to help prepare too. That said, when we get to the interview and assessment stage, we’re really interested in hearing your unique perspective and real-world stories. That’s the stuff we can’t get from a bot or a prompt! 

 About us 

 

 The electric revolution has arrived - and from 2035 you’ll no longer be able to buy a new petrol or diesel car in the UK. 

 

 We’re building a whole new way for drivers to join the electric charge and not only learn about and shop for their EV online, but experience a 'lease for life' through an industry changing customer experience. This is the chance to join one of the UK’s most exciting start-ups – making it easy for individuals and businesses to go electric by getting their car, charger and energy all in one cracking deal.

 

 Octopus Electric Vehicles launched in 2018 to make it seamless to switch to cleaner, greener driving. Our mission is to drive sustainable change, decarbonise the planet and provide our customers with fair pricing and a fantastic experience. 

 

 We're an Octopus Energy company—an innovative new energy supplier. We are part of the Octopus Energy Group, which seeks to improve the lives of millions of people by transforming the industries we operate in. The Octopus Group incorporates Octopus Energy, Octopus Healthcar

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner - OpenCRQ
jobs.description:
🌀 The Company
 Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action. 
 Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.
 At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.
 As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.
  
 🎯 The Role 
 We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the product vision and roadmap for OpenCRQ , Filigran’s product focused on Threat-driven Risk Assessment and Cyber Risk Quantification (CRQ) .
  
 In this role, you’ll make clear, data-informed decisions about which problems to solve and why, helping customers move toward more quantitative, probabilistic risk management. You’ll act as a domain expert in cyber risk, challenge and shape the core product model, and align Product, Engineering, Business, and leadership around measurable user and business outcomes.
  
 You’ll also help define strategic ecosystem choices for OpenCRQ, including potential partnerships with the FAIR Institute , breach/data providers, and other relevant risk and cybersecurity ecosystem players.
  
 At Filigran, Product Managers are also expected to actively participate in the AI-driven development of prototypes , working hands-on with AI Agents to explore concepts, validate assumptions, and accelerate product discovery and delivery.
  
 💼 Your Responsibilities 
 Own the product vision and roadmap for OpenCRQ , with a strong Cyber Risk Quantification mindset.

 Challenge and shape the core product model, including the data model, emphasized controls, and how risk is communicated to customers.

 Lead customer and prospect discovery to validate direction, prioritize problems, and identify high-impact opportunities.

 Make clear, data-informed product decisions and align stakeholders around trade-offs and priorities.

 Work closely with Engineering and R&D leadership to turn product strategy into deliverable outcomes.

 Collaborate with Business, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, and leadership to ensure OpenCRQ creates measurable customer and business value.

 Evaluate and drive strategic ecosystem opportunities, such as FAIR Institute alignment and partnerships with breach/data providers.

 Contribute to Product Management practices, including AI-assisted product discovery, prioritization, and delivery workflows.
  

 🤝 Who You’ll Work With 
 You’ll report to the VP Product Management .

 You’ll work closely with other Product Managers, Engineering leadership, and the OpenCRQ engineering teams.

 You’ll collaborate with internal stakeholders across Leadership, Business, Customer Success, and Solutions Engineering.

 Key collaborators include the Director of Engineering for OpenCRQ and cross-functional product stakeholders.
  

 🧬 Profile We’re Looking For 
 Senior product leadership experience in B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, risk management, or a closely related domain.

 Strong ability to reason about quantitative and probabilistic risk , including threat distributions, likelihood, impact, and financial exposure.

 Credible understanding of cybersecurity from both attack and defense perspectives; a pure compliance background is not sufficient.

 Experience working with AI on the full product delivery cycle

 Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align Engineering, Product, Business, and leadership.

 Fluent in English ; French is a plus.

 Bonus: experience with open-source products or communities.

 🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job. 
 We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company , and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation . You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.
 
 ⭐ Be part of something bigger 
 We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative.
 
 💻 Work at the edge of what’s next 
 We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportu

jobs.title: [Paris] Product Manager (PO/PM)
jobs.description:
About Dedale: 
 Dedale is a fast-growing intelligence company. We are the go-to source for investment and strategic intelligence in the B2B technology market. Our product supports private-equity investors, corporate strategy teams and M&A advisors make sense of complex markets: proprietary intelligence on 50,000+ companies across 500+ Tech segments supported by market and deal data, expert perspectives.
 Our product is growing fast with more than 1,500 clients already relying on it and an ambitious roadmap to scale fast.
 
 About the role: 
 As our Product Manager (PO / PM), you will own product delivery across the full scope of the Dedale platform , end-to-end, from discovery to shipped feature. You will join our product and engineering team , report directly to the CPO , and work closely, day to day, with our 30+ data team, our research team, and our external design partner.
 You own your product area end-to-end: talk to internal and external users, shape the roadmap with the CPO, write the specs, guide the engineering team and drive delivery to launch. You own outcomes, not hand-offs : you decide what ships, define what “good” looks like, and make sure it lands. High-impact, high-autonomy, with a clear path toward Lead Product Manager and Product Director.
 One specificity of product at Dedale: our software is only as strong as the data beneath it. So part of the role is keeping the product and data roadmaps in step and working with our Head of Data and Senior Data Engineer so features and the data they rely on are ready together.Staying curious about new tools and approaches, and bringing that curiosity to the team.
 
 Your first 3 months: 
 First 2 weeks: get to know the platform, the users and the team, and take the backlog in hand

 First month: own the backlog and ship your first releases, at a steady cadence

 By month 3: run your product area end-to-end, discovery to launch; owning the roadmap, the quality bar, and the outcomes for your area

 
 Your Key Responsibilities: 
 Product Ownership & Delivery 
 Own the roadmap and a well-groomed backlog for the product, set with the CPO and prioritized on user value and impact

 Write crisp user stories, specs and acceptance criteria the engineering team can build from

 Partner with the engineering team to ensure they have all they require to ship in an agile and pro-active approach

 In alignment with the Head of Engineering, make scope and trade-off calls transparently, balancing value, effort and readiness

 Discovery & User Value 
 Talk to users (investors, analysts, research and go-to-market teams) and turn their pain points into problems worth solving

 Validate ideas quickly (user interviews, prototypes, data spot-checks) before committing build effort

 Brief and partner with our external design agency ; frame the problem, review designs in Figma , keep the bar high

 Define success metrics and track them post-release in PostHog (adoption, usage, satisfaction)

 Quality & Reliability 
 Own the definition of done and release acceptance: the product works, and the data behind it is correct, before it ships

 Hold a high quality bar: catch regressions, triage and prioritize bugs, fix root causes

 Monitor releases post-launch (usage, errors, data quality) and close the loop fast

 Partner with the engineering team to maintain a buffer for continuous improvement of the product and ensuring an increasing quality day-by-day

 Partner with engineering and data on test coverage and release readiness

 Keeping Tech & Data in sync our specificity, with the Head of Data and Senior Data Engineer 
 Co-plan releases so each feature and its data land together: no feature waiting on data, no data with nowhere to go

 Keep a shared view of what data (pipelines, enrichment, tagging, taxonomies) must be ready for which feature, and by when

 Communication & Stakeholder Management 
 Keep leadership, go-to-market and research stakeholders aligned on roadmap, progress and trade-offs and be the reliable translator between technical, data and business audiences

 
 What we are looking for: 
 Must-haves: 
 3 to 6 years as a Product Owner and/or Product Manager on a software product (ideally B2B SaaS)

 Strong agile delivery track record: backlog ownership, clear specs, and a habit of shipping regularly

 Solid product and business sense : you run discovery, understand needs and usage, prioritize well, and define and track success metrics

 Comfortable with data : you have worked on a product with a real data layer and can hold your own with data engineers on coverage and quality

 Fluent English is essential : it is our common working language, and many of the team don’t speak French. French is a plus, not a requirement

 Exposure to AI / LLM-powered features , search or retrieval products

 Nice-to-haves: 
 Familiarity with private equity, financial services, market intelligence or data-provider environments

 Analytical and hands-on: comfortable checking things yourse

jobs.description:
Pioneer of online flash sales since 2001 and key player in European e-commerce, Veepee collaborates with over 7,000 brands to offer highly discounted products available for a limited time. Operating across various sectors, including fashion, home, wine, travel or beauty... Veepee achieved a turnover of 3.3 billion euros incl. VAT in 2024 and employs 5,000 staff members across 10 countries. 
 

 

 
 As Senior CRM Project Manager for Personalized Promotions & Wallet reporting to the CRM Group Director, you will drive Veepee's promotional strategy across all six European markets (France, Benelux, Germany, Spain, Italy & Switzerland) and business scopes (Flash Sales, Brandsplace, Clearance, Media, Le Club).

 

 You own two interconnected mandates : 

 

 1/ Maximise the ROI of promotional marketing budget — covering all voucher and incentive mechanics across the full customer lifecycle, whether funded by Veepee or by brand partners.

 

 2/ Lead the CRM workstream of the Wallet & Promotional Products project — Veepee's flagship 2026–2028 initiative to transform the “Mes Promos” space into a personalized, gamified promotional wallet.

 

 You operate at the intersection of CRM strategy, product development and data. You influence without direct authority, acting as the bridge between the CRM team and other main stakeholders (Front/Growth, sourcing, finance teams).

 You are accountable for defining your OKRs, owning your roadmap and delivering measurable impact on promotional performance.

 🎯 TASKS 
 
 Promotional Budget Strategy & ROI Optimisation 

 
 Own the strategy and allocation of the voucher marketing budget across all lifecycle stages — acquisition, activation, engagement, reactivation.

 Define well-framed and scoped problems, linked to concrete business OKRs, based on evidence (expertise, data, feedback, etc.), and define functional features to answer these problems.

 Lead the execution with contribution of tech, data and operational teams

 Define the right promotional mechanics for the right moment: welcome offers, cashback, brand-funded vouchers, targeted incentives, win-back promos.

 Build and maintain a promotional performance framework: track ROI by mechanic, by market, by lifecycle stage, and by funding source (Veepee vs. brand partners).

 Identify optimisation levers and challenge the status quo — push toward more targeted, more personalised and more cost-efficient promotional strategies.

 Work closely with our CRM Data Steward to leverage the Voucher Performance tracking tools and A/B test dashboard; design and run structured tests on promotional mechanics.

 

 Wallet & Promotional Products — CRM Product Owner 

 
 Act as the CRM lead on the Wallet & Promo Products project — Veepee's strategic initiative to reinvent the promotional experience for members.

 Translate CRM strategy and member insights into concrete product requirements for the Front/Growth PM team.

 Define and champion the gamification vision for the promotional wallet: mechanics, member journey, engagement loops — this is a blank page and yours to write.

 Contribute actively to the product roadmap: challenge priorities, validate UX directions, and ensure CRM objectives are embedded in every sprint.

 Coordinate with our Head of CRM Engagement & Conversion and our Head of CRM Traffic & Recruitment to ensure promotional mechanics are consistently integrated into lifecycle journeys and traffic plans.

 Monitor the live rollout of product-specific promotions (currently in test) and drive the scaling strategy across markets.

 

 Cross-functional Influence & Alignment 

 
 Serve as the single point of contact for promotional topics within the CRM team and toward external stakeholders (Finance, Brand Partnerships, Product, Tech).

 Participate in CRM leadership discussions and contribute to the CRM team's collective roadmap — promotional levers are a shared enabler across all lifecycle strategies.

 Document everything: strategy, decisions, test results, roadmap contributions. Documentation is a deliverable, not an afterthought.

 

 👉 MUST HAVE skills 
 
 
 7–8 years of experience in CRM, promotional marketing, loyalty or incentive strategy — ideally in e-commerce or retail.

 Proven track record of managing and optimising a significant promotional or incentive budget with demonstrated ROI impact.

 Strong analytical profile: comfortable with performance data, A/B testing frameworks and KPI-driven decision making.

 Experience working at the intersection of marketing and product: able to translate business needs into product requirements and engage credibly with PM and Tech teams.

 Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills — you influence, align and drive without hierarchical authority.

 Structured thinker with strong project management discipline: you handle complexity, prioritise well and deliver on time.

 Fluent in English (working language). French is a strong plus.

 Our Impact: From General Meeting reports to AI-assisted contract life management, our teams across France, Spain, Italy, Canada, Mexico, and MEA are the driving force behind our global success.  Be the voice of our users – You are passionate about understanding customer needs and believe that talking with users is at the core of a Product Manager’s role. You thrive on identifying key pain points and turning them into impactful product solutions.

 Collaborate effectively inside and outside your squad: Work hand in hand with developers, product designer and other stakeholders to build the best possible solutions. You facilitate discussions around product impact and ensure incremental delivery of features.  

 

 
 
 
 
 Mesure, observe, iterate : Continuously engage with our users to refine the product, lead discovery discussions, and guide the team in prioritizing the most impactful improvements.  

 

 
 Profile required:

 Customer-first mindset : You are obsessed with user experience and love talking to customers. You have a strong ability to put yourself in their shoes, understand their challenges, and empathize with their needs.  

 

 
 
 
 Iterative mindset : you like to break down a big problem into smaller parts to continuously improve the value of the product  

 

 
 
 
 Analytical thinking – You feel comfortable working with data and using it to make informed product decisions.  

 

 
 
 
 Collaboration skills – You enjoy working in a team, exchanging ideas, and co-building solutions. You can communicate effectively with other team members and stakeholders to explain and advocate your choices. You can accept a tradeoff when it comes to delivering value to customers.  

 

 
 
 
 Growth mindset – You are eager to learn, improve, and take ownership of projects. You want to learn more how legal teams are working.  

 

 
 
 
 Language : you are fluent in English, Italian and/or French is a plus  

 

 
 
 
 Experience : a first experience in a B2B SaaS is required

 Above all, we succeed as a team, united by a common goal: collaboration.

 Our "Telework Charter" guarantees that you can find the right balance between "Onsite" and "Remote"; 

 

 
 
 
 
 Last but not least, all the day-to-day benefits of the CSE, lunch vouchers, profitsharing bonuses, etc…

 Location: Paris

 Type of contract : Full time, hybrid

Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

The Opportunity:

As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will be in charge of the messaging and positioning for a broad product area. Then you’ll work closely with product managers and the marketing team to deliver campaigns, content, events, and training that help buyers buy (and sellers sell) our value.

Product Marketing lives within the Product org rather than the Marketing org at Grafana Labs, and we think differently about the job. Rather than purely executing launches or campaigns, we want PMMs to teach product managers and engineers in our org how to think about growth and demand, and to codify product marketing knowledge into AI-forward tools and processes that anyone in the organization can use. Grafana Labs is a fast-paced and growing organization. jobs.title: Data Governance Project Manager
jobs.description:
Notre équipe Data Governance recherche un·e Data Governance Project Manager basé·e à Lille 

Chez Decathlon, nous croyons au pouvoir du sport pour unir et inspirer. 

Notre mission : rendre le sport accessible au plus grand nombre, partout dans le monde. Pour y parvenir, la data est au cœur de notre stratégie, elle guide chaque décision, de la conception du produit à l'expérience client Notre défi ? La rendre gouvernée, sûre et accessible à tous. 

Tu rejoindras le Data Governance Center of Excellence pour transformer nos politiques théoriques en réalités opérationnelles. Ta mission est double : Améliorer les dispositifs de contrôles de la données et garantir la conformité de nos actifs via un framework d’audit robuste. 

TA MISSION : ORGANISER LA STRATEGIE D'AUDIT ET DE CONTRÔLE DE NOS STANDARDS DE GOUVERNANCE

1. Stratégie d’Audit & Compliance

Ton rôle est de mesurer la conformité de l'organisation à nos standards de gouvernance sur l’intégralité de notre scope. 

  • Framework de Contrôle vs Audit : Définir la ligne de démarcation entre le contrôle continu (opérationnel/automatique) et l'audit périodique (stratégique/qualitatif).
  • Industrialisation : Identifier les contrôles éligibles à l’automatisation (ex: intégrité référentielle, fraîcheur via les Data Contracts) et piloter leur mise en œuvre avec les équipes Data Engineering.
  • Audit des "Invisibles" : Concevoir les protocoles(y compris plan d’audit, cartographie des risques et déclenchement de mission ad hoc) d'audit pour les critères non-automatisables (pertinence du dictionnaire de données, qualité des descriptions, respect des processus de classification Privacy), identifier les root cause, les risques et les responsabilités.
  • Gestion des non conformités : Définir la stratégie de suivi des écarts. Tu ne te contentes pas de pointer les problèmes, tu bâtis le framework qui aide les équipes à corriger le tir (scoring, plans d'actions, escalade).

2. Structuration

Tu jouera pleinement ton rôle dans la définition et dans l’amélioration continue de l’operating modèle des audits et des contrôles

  • Mandat : Faire valider le niveau de sponsor et de validation du mandat général et/ou des fiches de mission pour assurer le bon niveau d’engagement des audités. Les décisions devront s’articuler autour du cadre général d’Audit interne de Decathlon
  • Reporting : Communiquer les résultats des travaux et assurer le suivi de la mise en oeuvre des recommandations et, le cas échéant, du processus d’escalade
  • Interactions : Formaliser et faire vivre les rituels et procédures permettant d’optimiser les synergies entre les travaux d’audit et de contrôle et ceux des autres équipes de la gouvernance fédérée (Expertise & projets de CoE en particulier)

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • Expertise en Gouvernance & Data Architecture : Tu maîtrises les frameworks de référence (DAMA/DMBOK), tu comprends les enjeux des architectures modernes (architecture médaillon, Data Contracts, Data Product) et les formats de structuration de données (YAML/JSON)
  • Culture de l'Audit & de la Conformité : Tu as une solide expérience dans la définition de standards, de normes et de protocoles d'audit. Tu sais distinguer un contrôle opérationnel d'un audit de gouvernance et tu es capable de transformer un constat d'écart en un plan de remédiation pragmatique (KRI/KPI)
  • Leadership d'Influence & Change : Tu es à l’aise dans l'animation de communautés (Data Stewards, Producers). Tu sais vulgariser des sujets complexes, lever les points de friction entre technique et business, et porter une vision de "Gouvernance by design"

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

  • Un mode de travail Hybride ;
  • Possibilité de travailler dans l'un des bureaux de Decathlon Digital à Lille ou Paris;
  • Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ;
  • Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;
  • Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, certifications techniques dès la première année, formations internes et externes, etc.)
  • Package de rémunération (participation des employés aux actions de l'entreprise, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

  • Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows)

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager - Platform
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to take on the hardest problems in the data and integration platform that everything at Nelly runs on: how practice data gets into Nelly from dozens of practice management systems, how partners connect to us, and how that data becomes something every product can depend on. At Staff level, your scope follows the problem, across teams and over time into product-wide questions.
 The problem space: Every Nelly product, from documentation to billing to payments, depends on data that lives in a practice's management system. There are dozens of them, each with its own data model and interfaces. 
 How many practices we can serve, how much of their work we can automate, and how much they trust the result come down to four questions: can we connect, can we read and write deeply enough, is the data any good once it arrives, and can every product and team inside Nelly easily build on it?
 About Nelly 
 We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, solving the biggest challenges for patients and practices. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people.
 Why? Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality.
 What sets us apart: We work with the best team, which is why we give everything together every day. We believe in Talent Density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. Stagnation isn’t an option, which is why we invest heavily in growth. AI is an essential part of how we work at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable.
 
 Joining us, you will: 
 Own the strategy, metrics and roadmap for hard data and integration problems, from how data leaves a practice's system, through ingestion and modelling, to the products that rely on it, tied to real practice value and to how Nelly makes money

 Shape how partners connect to Nelly through our External API, so we can serve practices on any system and open new markets beyond Germany

 Define the core data every product relies on: what a patient, an appointment, a treatment plan or an invoice means, who owns it, and how fresh and reliable it is, with GDPR and health-data regulation built in from the start

 Make data and integration quality measurable and visible, and move it, because practices feel a silent failure long before we do

 Hold an end-to-end model of the platform and be a credible partner to engineering on architecture and trade-offs

 
 What you'll bring: 
 Agency. You go after the problems that matter most, including well beyond your immediate scope, rather than waiting for a roadmap to land on your desk

 Comfort in a high-velocity environment. You move fast, make bold but reversible calls, and challenge early and directly, including upward

 Business-outcome orientation. You're genuinely data-driven: you can name the metric each project moves and let evidence, not gut feel, drive prioritisation

 Technical fluency. You reason confidently about APIs, data models, data flows and how systems fit together, and you're a credible partner to senior engineers

 You build with AI. You use AI to move faster: prototyping to pressure-test an idea, taking a first pass on the analysis or the spec yourself, shipping the small things directly, so your time goes to judgment and the decisions that move the product

 7+ years of product management experience
 

 Even better if you have: 
 Built and shipped AI products

 Worked on data platforms or data products

 Built B2B SaaS in healthcare or another regulated industry

 Professional German language knowledge

 
 Our Interview Process: 
 Introduction to Nelly with TA

 Product craft interview with our Product manager

 Case study interview with Director of Product

 Onsite interview with hiring manager and stakeholders

 
 What we offer: 
 The people you get to work with. You will work alongside the brightest minds we could find, on hard problems, as a team. We take on challenges together and we never forget to have fun doing it.

 Room to grow faster than almost anywhere else. New challenges, more scope, real ownership from day one. We trust you to own it and to speak up when something is wrong. Just do not expect to stand still.

 A yearly learning and development budget , plus the coaching, feedback and internal knowledge that actually move you forward. Real investment

jobs.title: Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Description 
 We are seeking a product manager to own the "what" and "why" of our quantum sensing measurement systems. You turn customer and market needs into clear product requirements that engineering can turn into specifications, and you own the roadmap for the QDm product line, starting with QDm.1. You sit between our customers (foundries, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs) and every engineering discipline, and you make sure we build the right product in the right order.
  
  
 Who we are 
 Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.
  
 Why join QuantumDiamonds? 
 Picture this: 
 Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

 Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

 Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

 An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

 Still unsure about why joining us? 
 You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

 From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

 Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

 You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

 Let’s make the invisible visible! 
  
  
 What will you do 
 Own the product requirements: gather needs from customers, the field, the market, and internal stakeholders (serviceability, modularity and product configuration, manufacturability, and cost targets), and turn them into clear, prioritized, solution-neutral requirements.

 Establish our requirements engineering tooling and workflow: select and set up how we capture, trace, and maintain requirements, from customer need through specification to verification, including change control across releases. This is a foundational task in your first months.

 Own and maintain the QDm.1 roadmap: propose what gets built and in what order, make the trade-offs explicit, and align decisions with the management team.

 Work with the applications team on customer interactions and evaluations with fabs, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs, and translate what you learn into requirements.

 For each requirement, define acceptance criteria from the customer's point of view so it is clear and testable when the need is met, and link them to customer evaluation and qualification plans.

 Align with the Product Development department on scope and timing, and hand solution-neutral requirements into engineering: state the need and the why, and leave the how to the disciplines.

 Support go-to-market: give input on positioning, pricing, launch readiness, and documentation scope together with the applications, operations, and product development teams.

  
 What is expected of you 
 Several years in product management for complex hardware or capital equipment, ideally in semiconductor, metrology, or a comparable deep-tech environment.

 A track record of writing clear product requirements that engineering can actually build from.

 The ability to talk to both customers and engineers and to translate between them.

 Enough technical depth to hold a credible conversation with the people designing the product, across mechanics, optics, electronics/RF, and software.

 Structured prioritization: you make trade-offs explicit and back them with reasoning.

 We hire for demonstrated skill rather than a specific degree; a technical or scientific background is typical. The working language is English.

 Additional experience we value: 
 Semiconductor industry knowledge (fabs, IDMs, OSATs, inspection, metrology, or failure analysis).

 Familiarity with SEMI standards and fab tool integration (for example, S2/S8, E10, SECS/GEM).

 Experience selecting or setting up a requirements management tool (for example, Jama, Polarion, or CodeBeamer).

 A working understanding of quantum sensing, optics, or precision instrumentation.

  
 Our benefits 
 Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

 Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey,

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner Clinical Registries
jobs.description:
Our mission 
 We turn data into better healthcare. With our insights, we make healthcare more affordable and better, and we improve the patients’ and clinicians’ experience.
 
 Our mission 
 We turn data into better healthcare. With our insights, we make healthcare more affordable and better, and we improve the patients' and clinicians' experience.
 
 Your impact 
 Dutch clinical registries are among the richest sources of outcome data in Europe. At LOGEX, that data reaches clinicians and hospitals through applications such as Codman and Data Entry, and reaches researchers and healthcare professionals through data requests and exports. As Senior Product Owner you own that portfolio end to end: the applications that clinicians use every day, and the data pipelines that power them.
 You are the product owner for our largest registry partner and decide what gets built within a fixed capacity. You also make sure that what we build strengthens the wider LOGEX platform wherever possible.
 
 What you'll own 
 Applications: user-facing applications for manual data entry, dashboarding and exports – owning the roadmap, priorities and release quality.

 Pipelines and business logic: registry processing (merge, load, curation), data exports, scientific data requests, data linkage and registry development sets.

 One backlog, two types of developers: you lead the product work of a team that combines data engineers with back-end and front-end developers. You translate user and partner’s needs into work for both, and you see early where a front-end change depends on a pipeline change.

 Prioritisation within fixed capacity: you align with one counterpart at our largest registry partner on what gets built and when, with transparent trade-offs, realistic yearly planning and a clear path to extra capacity when it is funded.

 Reusable by design: you turn partner-specific needs into shared LOGEX components wherever possible, in close collaboration with other Product Owners and Product Managers.

 Regulatory and standards readiness: you make sure the products keep meeting healthcare regulation and move along with open data standards, e.g. FHIR.

 Run and improve: you balance new development with maintenance and technical debt, and you help to reduce key-person risk in a small team.

 Customer-facing: you work closely with the Customer Office on scope, project proposals and delivery expectations, and you represent the products in partner and user sessions.

 
 What you bring 
 At least 5 years of experience as product owner or product manager

 Proven experience with healthcare analytics or healthcare data: you understand how clinical, operational or registry data becomes insight

 Experience working with a team of mixed engineering profiles

 Experience managing a demanding, influential stakeholder or key client

 Commercial awareness: you understand the difference between paid and internal work, and what it means for team capacity

jobs.title: Product Lead 100%
jobs.description:
Unsere Mission 
 Photovoltaik wirtschaftlich, einfach und sorglos machen. Wir bringen die Energiewende ins Gebäude – mit intelligenten Lösungen für Eigenverbrauch & Elektromobilität, die sich für alle lohnen: Investor:innen, Nutzer:innen und unsere Zukunft.
 Als ZEV-Pionierin ist Smart Energy Link heute die führende Schweizer B2B-Plattform für Abrechnung und intelligente Steuerung dezentraler Energieinfrastruktur. Mit einem Team von rund 35 Mitarbeitenden haben wir bereits über 700 Projekte erfolgreich realisiert und betreuen mehr als 20'000 Wohneinheiten im Bereich ZEV und Metering.
 Deine Rolle 
 SEL wächst vom Start-up zum Scale-up – und du gestaltest unsere Produkte in dieser Phase aktiv mit. Als Product Lead verantwortest du unsere Webportale inklusive der Abrechnungslösung und treibst die Produktstrategie gemeinsam mit dem CEO, dem UX-Team und der Entwicklung voran. Du denkst strategisch, führst die Product Discovery und packst bei der Umsetzung mit an – kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheide, echter Gestaltungsspielraum.
 Du verantwortest den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg deiner Produkte, inklusive Preisgestaltung und Markteinführung.

 Du übersetzt Kunden- und Marktbedürfnisse in eine klare Produkt-Roadmap – im Rahmen der regulatorischen Vorgaben (ZEV/vZEV/LEG).

 Du entwickelst unsere Webportale zu einer skalierbaren Plattform weiter und verantwortest die Produkt-Vision, -Strategie und -Roadmap.

 Du sorgst für die marktgerechte Weiterentwicklung der Abrechnungslösung.

 Das bringst du mit 
 Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-SaaS-Plattformen, mit agilen Entwicklungsmethoden und in der Skalierung. Technische Konzepte verstehst du so gut, dass du mit der Entwicklung auf Augenhöhe diskutieren kannst.

 Du bringst Erfahrung in Abrechnungs- und Inkassoprozessen mit, idealerweise in einem ZEV- (vZEV, LEG) Umfeld.

 Du kennst die Stromtarifmodelle im europäischen Raum und die regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen der Schweiz (Energiewirtschaft).

 Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und nutzt beide Sprachen im Alltag

 Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und teamorientiert

 Du hast eine hohe KI-Affinität.

 Schön, aber kein Muss: 
 Erfahrung mit Elektromobilität oder Smart Grid · Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung interdisziplinärer Teams · technischer Studienabschluss (z. B. Informatik, Elektro-/Energietechnik) oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.
 Was wir bieten: 
 Bei SEL arbeitest du an etwas, das zählt: Du prägst die Zukunft des Schweizer Energiesektors mit – Tag für Tag.
 Bring dich ein und gestalte die Firma aktiv mit - inkl. Mitarbeiterbeteiligung.

 Wir fördern dein Lernen & Wachstum und beteiligen uns an Kursen, Aus- und Weiterbildungen.

 Wir leben Flexibilität: Du gestaltest deinen Arbeitsalltag weitgehend selbst 

 Wir arbeiten mit Jahresarbeitszeit und einer 40-Stunden-Woche.

 plus: NIKIN-Hoodie, Füürabe-Aareschwumm und Glace im Gfrüürfach

 Wir sind ein agiles Team, das sich gegenseitig schätzt, fordert und weiterbringt – offen, direkt und auf Augenhöhe. Wenn du Lust hast, wirklich etwas zu bewegen: Werde Energiepionier:in bei SEL.
 So geht's weiter 
 Bewirb dich direkt – wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Tage bei dir. Unser Prozess: ein kurzes Kennenlerngespräch per Telefon oder Video, ein ausführliches Interview vor Ort oder remote und ein Schnuppertag, an dem du unser Team und unsere Arbeitsweise hautnah erlebst. Wir freuen uns, von dir zu hören.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
About Orakl Oncology 
 Every cancer patient deserves a treatment that works for them. Today, too many never get one in time: fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs make it through clinical trials and every failure costs patients precious time .
 Orakl exists to change those odds.
 We bridge biological and artificial intelligence by building large cohorts of virtual cancer patients: real patients’ tumors, paired with their medical history and deep biological data. By combining patient-derived tumor models, deep biological data and AI, we help pharmaceutical companies predict how cancer drugs will perform in patients, identify promising treatments and make better decisions earlier in development.
 We were founded in 2023 by Fanny Jaulin, PhD, Diane-Laure Pagès, PhD and Gustave Ronteix, PhD as a spin-out from Gustave Roussy, one of Europe's leading cancer centers, building on a decade of research. We are backed by top international VC investors and we are scaling our technology and partnerships with pharmaceutical companies worldwide.
 Discover more here: Orakl's website .
 
 The role 
 We are looking for Orakl's first Product Marketing Lead to shape how we bring our technology to market, from understanding our customers and positioning our offerings to building the commercial narratives and tools that help us win.
 You will sit at the intersection of science, product and business development, turning complex scientific capabilities into compelling propositions for pharma and biotech customers.
 Your job is to understand what our customers need, articulate why Orakl is uniquely positioned to deliver it, and help translate our technology into offerings that customers understand, trust and buy.
 Working directly with our founders, BD and scientific teams, you will own product positioning, go-to-market strategy and commercial enablement, collaborating with our Communications & Events Lead on external launches and campaigns.
 This is a hands-on role with significant strategic ownership and the opportunity to build Orakl's product marketing function from the ground up.
 
 What you will do 
 
 Market intelligence and customer understanding 
 Customer discovery. Develop a deep understanding of pharma and biotech customers through interviews, prospect conversations and close collaboration with BD. Identify their priorities, decision-making processes, objections and unmet needs.

 Customer segmentation. Define and refine Orakl's ideal customer profiles, priority market segments and key buying personas across translational research, clinical development, R&D leadership and BD/licensing teams.

 Competitive intelligence. Map the competitive landscape, including in-house models, CROs and other AI platforms. Identify where Orakl wins, why it wins and how to communicate its differentiation.

 Market feedback. Build a continuous feedback loop between customers, BD and scientific teams, translating market insights into recommendations for offering development and commercial strategy.

 Product positioning and go-to-market strategy 
 Offering strategy and positioning. Work with BD, scientific teams and leadership to translate Orakl's capabilities into compelling commercial offerings, defining target customers, use cases, differentiation and competitive alternatives.

 Messaging and value propositions. Develop clear, differentiated messaging for each offering and buyer persona, translating complex science into tangible scientific and business value.

 Go-to-market strategy. Develop go-to-market plans for priority offerings and customer segments, defining target audiences, core propositions, competitive differentiation and commercial activation alongside BD.

 Product launches. Lead the product marketing side of new offering launches, from positioning and messaging to materials and BD readiness, working with the Communications & Events Lead, who owns external announcements.

 Pricing and packaging. Support BD and leadership in defining how offerings are structured, packaged and priced based on customer needs, market insights and competitive positioning.

 Commercial enablement and impact 
 BD enablement. Build and own Orakl's commercial toolkit, including pitch decks, one-pagers, case studies, scientific summaries, proposal templates and competitive battlecards, tailored to different customers and use cases.

 Scientific proof. Build and maintain a library of validation data, publications, case studies and partner references, translating scientific evidence into credible commercial arguments.

 Team enablement. Equip BD and scientific teams with the messaging, materials and competitive knowledge they need to communicate Orakl's value consistently and effectively.

 Conference and event content. Develop product messaging, scientific content and demos for conferences, webinars and industry events, working alongside the Communications & Events Lead, who manages event execution.

jobs.title: Senior AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
About 9fin 
 9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.
 Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.
 Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.
 We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.
 
 The Opportunity
 Our AI product area is growing. We already have two Product Managers working across conversational AI, agentic workflows, and domain-specific automation, and we need a third to expand our capacity as the scope of AI at 9fin accelerates.
 Backed by over $170M in funding (Series C), we are scaling rapidly across product, engineering, and go-to-market. AI is not a bolt-on feature at 9fin; it is the core differentiator for the next phase of the company.
 You will join an established AI PM team and take ownership of a product area within our AI surface. This could span new AI-powered features for credit analysts, workflow automation for legal and financial analysis, or expanding our conversational AI into new domains. The team has already built evaluation infrastructure and quality frameworks; you will use and contribute to these rather than build them from scratch.
 You will work within our product organization (eight squads across AI, data, and domain verticals) and partner closely with ML engineers, data scientists, domain experts, and designers. This is a high-autonomy role with real scope to shape what 9fin's AI products can do for our clients.
  
 What You'll Do

Vous consacrez entre 30 et 50 % de votre temps à guider l’évolution de l'expérience utilisateur de nos applications : vous encadrez la vie de notre design system, vous veillez à la cohérence et à la qualité de nos interfaces, et vous accompagnez l’évolution des parcours utilisateurs de nos applications.  À l'aise pour aller chercher l'information directement sur le terrain, chez les clients ; une pratique de la recherche utilisateur est un plus

jobs.title: Bid & Project Manager – EU & NATO (H/F)
jobs.description:
About Alta Ares
 
Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.
 Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.
 Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.
 Role & Mission 
 NATO agencies & EU programs are investing in counter-drone capability now, and Alta Ares answers a fast-growing flow of their tenders and calls for proposals. As Bid & Project Manager in our EU, NATO & Eastern Flank team, you turn each opportunity into a compliant offer, then into a project delivered on time. Your sales director owns the customer relationship and the commercial strategy; you own the offer and its delivery.
 This is not a one-programme job. You will run several bids and projects at once: a NATO bid, an EU grant proposal, and an RFI can land in the same week, and none of them can slip.
 This is a demanding, high-ownership role. Deadlines do not move, the stakes are real, and the team will rely on you to hold the line. We are looking for someone who wants that responsibility.
 
 Bid Management - from first read to submission 
 Screen and qualify opportunities with your sales director; prepare bid/no-bid decisions with risks, resources, and price on the table

 Break each tender down (NATO IFB or RFQ, EU call, RFP for a Nation through EU-NATO platforms such as NSPA or SAFE joint procurement) into a compliance matrix, a bid plan and clear owners

 Write and assemble the management, technical and compliance volumes with Engineering, Product, Finance and Legal

 Organise the review gates and prepare the final price review with Finance; submit complete, compliant and on time, every time

 Run the clarification rounds and support your sales director in negotiations through to contract signature

 
 NATO & EU Procurement - the rules of the game 
 Master NSPA and NCIA procedures: Source File registration, declarations of eligibility, notifications of intent, IFBs and RFQs, basic ordering agreements and framework contracts

 Run EU grant proposals (European Defence Fund, EDIP): Funding & Tenders portal, consortium building, Part A and Part B, lump-sum budgets

 Track national procurement rules and partners on the Eastern Flank through EU-NATO (Poland, Romania, the Baltic States…), e.g. via NSPA or SAFE joint procurement

 Build and maintain the bid library: company documents, CVs, past performance, standard answers, templates

 
 Project Delivery - from award to acceptance 
 Turn each award into a project: kick-off, plan, milestones, risks, budget and change control

 Coordinate engineering, production, demo and logistics teams, and partners, to deliver what we promised when we promised it

 Own customer reporting, deliverables and acceptance (FAT/SAT), with the documentation trail for invoicing and audits

 Run several projects in parallel, each at a different stage

 
 Process & Reporting 
 Set the bid and project rhythm for the team: calendar, gates, templates, dashboards

 Review the status of every live bid and project weekly with your sales director: deadlines, compliance, risks, resources needed

 Run lessons learned after every bid, won or lost

 
 Candidate Profile 
 5+ years in bid, proposal or project management in defence, aerospace or security

 Proven record of compliant, on-time submissions to NATO agencies, EU programmes or European ministries of defence, several of them in parallel

 At least one defence contract delivered from award to acceptance

 Scale-up or lean-team experience is a significant advantage; prime experience is welcome if you want more breadth and speed

 Skills & Qualities 
 Rigorous and precise compliance is binary; in defence, the margin for error is zero

 Built for parallel work you run several bids and projects at once, prioritise hard and never drop the ball

 Committed you own the outcome, not just your part of it; submission peaks are part of the job and you plan for them

 Calm under pressure fixed deadlines, late amendments and competing requests do not throw you

 A clear writer structured, scoreable English; you turn engineering input into compliant answers

 A leader without authority you get engineers, Finance, Legal and partners to deliver on time

 Technically curious you understand how sensors, effectors, C2 and AI fit together, or you learn it fast

 Discreet and trustworthy you handle sensitive commercial and defence information as a matter of course

 Mission-driven you care about European security, not just the job title

 Nice to Have 
 APMP, Shipley, PMP, PRINCE2 or IPMA certification

 Experience on a European Defence Fund or EDIP consor

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead - AI Stockbroking
jobs.description:
About BJAK 
 The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
  
 The Role 
 BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
  
 These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
  
 The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
  
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
  

 What We're Looking For 
 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
  

 Nice to have 
 Engineering or highly technical product background.

 Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
  

 Outcome 
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
  

 Location 
 This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 
  
 Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
  
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 Online assessment or practical task

 Technical interview

 CEO / final round

  
 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Interactive Avatars (Staff/Principal-level)
jobs.description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. 
 As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.
 Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.
 
 About the role 
 For years, avatars have been something you watch. You write a script, we render a video, someone presses play. That model has taken AI video a long way but it has a ceiling. A video can't answer a question. It can't read the room. It can't role-play a tough conversation and adapt when you push back.
 We're changing that. Interactive Avatars listen, talk, and respond in real time; inside your product, your website, or your internal tools. You bring the logic and the language model; we power the avatar layer: the speech, the expression, the listening, the sense that there's someone actually there.
 It's early. Interactive Avatars is in closed beta today, and the teams building on it are pushing it into places we didn't expect - AI sales reps, always-on support agents, interactive trainers, onboarding guides. We're hiring a Product Manager to own it and take it from beta to a platform that thousands of developers build on.
 This is a role with real scope. You'll help define what a real-time avatar API should be, the surface developers integrate against, the experience end users feel, and the commercial model that makes it a business. You'll work directly with the engineering and research teams building the real-time avatar stack, and with the design partners already live in the beta.
  
 The problem you're solving 
 Today, a developer who wants a lifelike, real-time avatar in their product has to stitch together a streaming pipeline, a rendering layer, an agent, and a set of hard real-time problems - latency, interruption handling, listening behavior, expressiveness, consistency across sessions, most of which have nothing to do with the product they're actually trying to build.
 We have the avatar technology and a working beta. What we need is a PM who can turn that into an API a developer can integrate in an afternoon, trust in production, and build a real business on top of, all while holding a quality bar high enough that the experience feels human, not uncanny.
  
 What you'll be doing 
 Owning the end-to-end Interactive Avatar API. This is the developer-facing surface (SDK, integration patterns, docs), the real-time experience quality, and the path from closed beta to general availability, and defining what the roadmap looks like over the coming cycles

 Getting close to the developers and teams building on the beta: understanding how they integrate, where the API fights them, which real-time behaviors make or break the experience, and what "production-ready" means to them

 Translating that understanding into a clear product direction. What to build, in what order, and why, and keeping the team aligned as the strategy evolves

 Working closely with the engineering and research teams building the real-time avatar stack; contributing clear specs, sound judgment on trade-offs (quality vs. latency vs. cost), and the context that helps them build the right thing the first time

 Partnering with go-to-market and commercial teams to define how the API is packaged, priced, and sold - a real-time API has a fundamentally different business model from batch video, and shaping that is part of the job

 Defining and tracking the metrics that tell us whether the product is working across adoption, integration success, real-time quality, reliability, and the commercial signals that prove it's a business

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager (Product Development)
jobs.description:
About Us : AI compute is hitting a hard physical wall, and memory bottlenecks are throttling the entire industry. Founded in October 2024 and backed by €57M in funding, Vertical Compute is solving this with proprietary Vertical Integrated Memory (VIM™) chiplets, making AI hardware faster, greener, and vastly more scalable. We are an interdisciplinary team transforming breakthrough semiconductor physics into commercial reality. 
 
 Why Now : After 18 months of intensive R&D, Vertical Compute has reached a critical inflection point. Our underlying technology is validated, and we have successfully met our core technical milestones. Armed with a proven technical data package and ongoing system studies, we are now shifting from pure R&D to active engagement with global enterprise customers. As we prepare for our next phase of scale and growth starting in 2027, joining us today means taking direct ownership of the hardware foundation that will power the next era of AI compute. 
 
 About the role: 
 You will oversee key technical initiatives to deliver our unified hardware and software platform. You will play a crucial role in transitioning products from initial development into commercial production. Taking full ownership of execution, you will bridge technology delivery with strategic commercial goals. 

 Key responsibilities: 
 Own the cross-functional execution framework for complex silicon and software development programs from early architecture through tapeout, post-silicon bring-up, and release. 

 Partner closely with hardware, software, architecture, and product teams to drive alignment on milestones, roadmaps, and execution reviews. 

 Establish scalable execution practices, manage program dependencies, and proactively mitigate risks across hardware and software integration efforts. 

 Manage cross-functional dependencies and program delivery flow to ensure seamless execution. 

 Drive regular program-level product demonstrations to validate milestones and gather stakeholder feedback. 

 Lead continuous improvement initiatives to refine operational processes and team coordination. 

 Proactively identify and resolve architectural or organizational blockers, managing risk and maintaining relentless progress from initial exploration to customer acceptance. 

 Identify execution risks, lead risk mitigation plans, and drive trade-off decisions across scope, schedule, resources, and quality 

 About the team: 
 This role is part of the operations team, partnering closely with our cross-functional engineering teams in System & Product and Memory Design. We foster a highly collaborative, inclusive environment where strong alignment, high transparency and seamless team coordination are central to our shared success. 
 
 
 
 About who you are: 
 Masters or higher in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Physics or a related technical field. Ability to understand the system and the sub-systems. 

 Strong technical foundation in hardware design, memory architecture, advanced packaging, chiplets, and AI acceleration technologies. 

 Proven track record in technical program management within the semiconductor industry, with experience delivering complex products that integrate novel hardware with firmware. 

 Data-driven; actively leveraging AI tools in daily workflows. 

 Relentless Improvement Mindset. 

 Adaptive and servant leadership style and problem-solving fluency in a cross-functional organization working on complex hardware-software integration. 

 Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication abilities. 

 
 
 Location : Leuven (Belgium) / Grenoble (France) / Remote. Regular travel is expected to support effective and efficient collaboration and keep pace with our rapid growth.

 Who we are 
 We are a fast-growing high-tech company with a clear mission: accelerating the transition to sustainable mobility through hands-free charging technology.
 By combining soft robotics, computer vision, and software, we build reliable solutions that make fleet electrification easier and more scalable.
 
 We are a global organization, headquartered in Rijswijk, the Netherlands, with a U.S. office in Portland, OR.
 
 Together, we are building a cleaner future.
 
 You make the difference

 What makes this role impactful is your ability to coordinate complex project delivery across two distinct axes:
 
 Multidisciplinary R&D Execution: You synchronize highly diverse engineering tracks—including hardware, electronics, embedded/cloud software, computer vision, AI, and robotics—to ensure integrated system delivery.

 Cross-Departmental Alignment: Rather than defining requirements or architecture, you own the execution bridge. You translate Product Management’s strategic roadmap into R&D milestones, and manage the operational handover to Manufacturing, Sourcing, and Service.
 

 Your core focus remains on tracking the critical path, keeping timelines rigid, and safeguarding quality and cost boundaries.
 
 In this role you will 
 
 Drive Multidisciplinary Engineering Execution 
 Collaborate closely with and align engineers across a wide variety of technical disciplines: system engineering, hardware design, electronics, embedded software, cloud applications, computer vision, AI, and robotics.

 
 Manage End-to-End NPI Projects 
 Lead complex product development cycles.

 Relentlessly manage project schedules, proactively tracking dependencies and safeguarding the critical path and scope.

 
 Support Cross-Functional Collaboration 
 Establish transparent communication loops between R&D teams and internal business pillars (Supply Chain, Production, Field Service, and Procurement).

 Communicating technical engineering status updates for high-level strategic alignment with product management and executives.

 
 What you will bring into Rocsys 
 
 Your knowledge and experience : 
 A completed Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in a highly technical field or Business Administration with an affinity with deep-tech.

 A minimum of 5 years of proven experience as a project manager within a high-tech, complex product development or R&D environment.

 Demonstrated track record of successfully delivering complex hardware-software integrated products.

 A technical foundation allowing you to think critically at a systems level and engage constructively with domain experts across technical disciplines.

 Clear and concise communication skills.

 Willing to travel occasionally to support key validation or deployment phases.

 Experience working within an international technical organization.
 

 What we offer  
 A 32–40 hour work week

 Hybrid working model with flexible hours

 Salary range between € 7.500 and € 10.500 gross monthly

 Employee stock option plan

 25 vacation days, with the option to purchase 5 additional days

 Bicycle plan

 Strong career development opportunities as we scale

 A dynamic and collaborative company culture

 Free daily vegetarian lunch

 Wednesday afternoon drinks

 Easily accessible office in Rijswijk

 
 *This role is based in the Netherlands. Applicants must currently reside in Europe and be legally authorized to work within the European Union. 
 
 Our company values 
 We own it! 

 Relentlessly Inventive

 People with Passion

 Leave a Better Planet
